raw_segments.text: He was already handing mincemeat down his throat in the most curious manner, more like
a man who was putting it away somewhere in a violent hurry than a man who was eating
it, but he left off to take some of the liquor.
He shivered all the while so violently that it was quite as much as he could do to keep
the neck of the bottle between his teeth without biting it off.
